title: Electrical Power and Energy Bills

problems_fixed.what: Duplicate solution with bronze[0] (both = 6). Changed heater time 3 h to 4 h so energy = 8 kWh (was 6 kWh). Misconception and guided walk recomputed.
Duplicate solution with bronze[4] (both = 300). Changed motor time 40 s to 30 s so power = 400 W (was 300 W). Misconceptions and guided walk recomputed.

opener_concept: The electricity meter counts 'units'. One unit runs a 1 kW appliance for 1 hour and costs about 30p, so 3 hours of a 1 kW heater cost 30 x 3 = 90p, and a 2 kW heater uses 2 x 3 = 6 units. A student answers by pure common sense (rate x time), and the reveal names it as the billing rule energy (kWh) = power (kW) x time (hours).
